themes: The reward described in the Quran
summary_for_children: Surah Muhammad speaks of believers and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and describes rivers promised to the righteous. We only learn about them from the Quran.
environment_concept: A reading stand with the ayah that describes rivers (47:15; the rivers themselves are not pictured), a quiet garden and stepping stones for steady feet (47:7).
architecture_and_scenery: Abstract channels of light labelled by the ayah: water unaltered, milk, honey; a calm garden edge.

areas.name: Rivers Described
areas.description: Four abstract streams of light, each labelled with the ayah; symbolic only.

activities.name: Read the description
activities.description: Read 47:15 and match each stream label; no picture of Paradise is claimed.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Good deeds
activities.description: Lay five numbered stones in order: feet planted firmly.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration explicitly says the unseen is known only through the Quran.
learning_objectives: Explain helping Allah's cause by good deeds

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (lectern, orchard, spring) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
